a1.label: 1. The team completed...
a1.why: The text says the team completed eight of the ten sprint backlog items.

a2.label: 2. The data migration was finished...
a2.why: The text says the data migration was finished ahead of schedule.

a3.label: 3. The customer was happy with...
a3.why: The text says the customer was very happy with the KPI visualisations.

a4.label: 4. The recurring problem is...
a4.why: The text says tickets are blocked because the test environment is unstable.

a5.label: 5. Daniel is going to...
a5.why: The text says Daniel will set up a second environment next week.

a6.label: 6. Before Monday's meeting, the team should...
a6.why: The text asks everyone to update tickets in the repository before the meeting.

b1.label: 1. Short work cycles in Scrum
b1.why: In Scrum, work is organised into short cycles called sprints.

b2.label: 2. All open tasks are collected in the product ___
b2.why: All open tasks are collected in the product backlog.

b3.label: 3. Completing the beta version was a ___
b3.why: An important achievement in a project timeline is a milestone.

b4.label: 4. Anyone affected by the project's outcome
b4.why: A stakeholder is anyone affected by the project's outcome.

b5.label: 5. Measuring success with response time, uptime
b5.why: KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) measure success, like response time and uptime.

b6.label: 6. Git is the most popular tool for ___
b6.why: Git is the most popular tool for version control.

b7.label: 7. ___ methods like Scrum respond quickly to change
b7.why: Agile methods like Scrum respond quickly to change.

c1.label: 1. We ___ eight of the ten items
c1.why: ‘We’ is plural, so the present perfect uses ‘have completed’.

c2.label: 2. The data ___ migrated
c2.why: ‘The data’ is treated as singular here, so the passive present perfect uses ‘has been’.

c3.label: 3. Maria ___ present the backlog
c3.why: ‘Is going to’ describes a planned future action at Monday's meeting.

c4.label: 4. The customer ___ the export function yet
c4.why: ‘Yet’ with a singular subject takes the present perfect negative ‘hasn't seen’.

c5.label: 5. ___ you ever worked with Kanban?
c5.why: ‘Have’ + subject + past participle + ‘ever’ forms a present perfect experience question.

c6.label: 6. The tickets ___ updated before the meeting
c6.why: ‘Will be’ + past participle is the future passive.

c7.label: 7. The test environment ___ unstable since Sprint 12
c7.why: ‘Since’ signals the present perfect for a state continuing to now.
